title: From Melting Pots to Misrepresentations: Exploring Harms in Generative AI

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting a text-to-image model (Imagen 2) with varying socioeconomic class descriptors (e.g., 'upper class family', 'middle-class family', 'working-class family') and analyzing the generated outputs and policy-based refusals.

Prompting a text-to-image model with racial, ethnic, and geographic demographic terms combined with socioeconomic descriptors (e.g., 'upper-class Asian family', 'upper-class South American family') to observe unresponsiveness, erasure, and representation failures.
Qualitative analysis of generated images for generic prompts (e.g., 'An upper class family') to identify default representations that heavily skew towards Western norms and the 'Western gaze'.
